summary: FAIL, 6 of 8 at par. Ardit (7.5) and Burdam (7.5) now clear, Vashil, Kemdo, Nurrow and Ervet hold. Lisvel 7.0 keeps its blocker: the base splash face is still blank. Ulkro 7.4: its recall is still nearly frozen despite the claim. done:1, 2, 3, 5 pass; done:4 partly; done:6 fails on the two fighters.

My own live capture walking away at the default camera shows a round dome over the dark stole, no peak (_harness/_shots/fw_CW5_r2v1_vashil_back_run.png, crop _back_crop.png). The GLB has not changed since 2ac1fc3d. No sensitivity concern.

Per-skin plates and stagings seen on the contact sheets (_harness/_shots/fw_CW5_r2v1_portrait_0.png, _1.png, splash_0.png, splash_1.png). Vashil base bust yaw 28 at art/blender/fighters/vashil.py:241. The numeric criterion is met; the Lisvel face at splash size is charged to lisvel-M1, not here.

Re-measured (fw_CW5_r2v1_chains.txt): Ardit tabard seg1 26.3 deg, lag 2 f, r 0.98; Burdam cowl_b 10.4 deg, skirt_f 17.1 deg; Kemdo robe_f 24.7 deg, lag 2 f; Lisvel tabard 35.1 deg, lag 2 f; Nurrow cape 20.1 / 13.8 deg; Ulkro skirt_f 22.5 deg, tail 7.7 / 14.7 deg. Vashil recall run live through the actor: clip 6 s over the 7 s channel, 0 wraps, end at 0.99 (fw_CW5_r2v1_recall_vashil.json). Rod steps per 60 Hz frame: Peal 0.265 m, Toll 0.155 m (fw_CW5_r2v1_steps2.txt), both <= 0.3. Lisvel dash floor passes. Weak spots, not gating: Burdam cowl xcorr r 0.23; Ardit tabard seg2 has 30 deg single-frame steps.

Met: Ervet blade L* range 30.8 reproduced from form_base UVs on the shipped GLB (fw_CW5_r2v1_store_blade.txt); Ulkro wraps shipped; part_lab exists. Not met: Lisvel painted material pass, sleeves and straps still read as clay (art/renders/fighters/lisvel/three_lisvel.png row 3). Ulkro's pass is incomplete: quiver case still has brush smears, dawnglass is still matte. Burdam pauldron spread reproduced at 34.1 vs 35 on an ROI, not id-masked; part_lab reports no part map for burdam or vashil (fw_CW5_r2v1_part_lab.txt). Recess depth 25.2 L* overshoots the 15-20 band. Gameplay-camera dE >= 8 per named pair is still unmeasured by anyone.
items.fixHint: Rebuild Lisvel with painted linen folds and weave, leather edges and bow grain. Rebuild Burdam to create its part map. Then measure the pairs with id masks in the gameplay-camera row.
